About Me

I am a BSc Computer Science and Engineering student at Metropolitan University, Sylhet, with an overall CGPA of 3.93 / 4.00 across my first seven semesters.

I have worked with C, C++, Java, Python, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and MySQL. My projects range from full-stack web applications to hardware work and social-impact concepts.

My current academic direction is becoming increasingly research-driven. I am particularly interested in responsible AI, algorithmic fairness, human-centered technology, and building systems that can create practical value for real people.

A research-based platform for auditing whether generative AI gives systematically different career recommendations to equally qualified profiles when controlled demographic cues change. The project combines responsible AI research with a full-stack web system.

ReactPython / API layerDatabaseLLM APIsData Analysis

Key Features

  • Controlled candidate-profile experiments
  • AI recommendation collection and comparison
  • Fairness metrics and visual analytics
  • Researcher dashboard and experiment history
  • Fairness-aware recommendation approach
